resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Carey give 1934; Peakbagging gives 1935. The record uses 1934 because two sources agree and the register's photo caption dates the lookout to 1934.
The register calls the cab a California Region 5 Plan BC-301 cabin; Carey calls it a classic C3 cab. Both describe a 30 foot K-braced steel tower, so the tower height is not in dispute.

sources.title: Santa Ynez (LO site), Santa Barbara County, California

notes_for_editor: Built year conflicts (1934 register and Carey vs 1935 Peakbagging). Removal date is unknown in all sources read. No source read says whether the site is open to the public now, so access is omitted rather than guessed; the brief's 'unknown' stays. Carey's 2013 post describes a visit made about the winter of 2011-12, not a 2013 visit. Photos on firetower.org ('Location of removed tower', Carey) were not downloaded. The register's 'Santa Ynez Lookout' photo caption and the blog comment about a lookout named Gus Grimm (1965) were not used, since comments are not sourced evidence.
